name: @botiverse/raft-desktop-electron
description: Raft Desktop — the native macOS app for Raft, bundling its own frontend and connecting directly to the Raft backend.
author: Botiverse

scripts.build:main: rm -f dist/*.js dist/*.cjs dist/*.map && tsup --config tsup.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --experimental-test-module-mocks --test src/main/linuxBuildOrigin.test.ts src/main/cursorSdkMenuController.test.ts src/main/cursorSdkE2eBuild.test.ts src/app/cursorSdkAssets.test.ts src/main/lifecycle.test.ts src/main/windowState.test.ts src/main/menubarResident.test.ts src/main/shutdown.test.ts src/main/shutdown.integration.test.ts src/main/quitFlow.test.ts src/main/loginItem.test.ts src/app/serviceRecycle.test.ts src/app/computerHost.convergeState.test.ts src/app/computerHost.sessionGate.test.ts src/app/computerHost.connectionCancel.test.ts src/app/computerHost.archive.test.ts src/app/sessionOriginGuard.test.ts src/app/deploymentConnection.test.ts src/app/oauthLoopback.test.ts src/app/serverOriginConfig.test.ts src/app/oauthCoordinator.test.ts src/app/enableInput.test.ts src/app/storageDoctor.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/computer/thisComputerLogic.ablation.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/computer/thisComputerAppManaged.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/computer/DesktopOnboardingComputerMount.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/notificationDecision.test.ts frontend/src/desktop/computer/convergeNotice.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build:cursor-assets && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:cursor-assets && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:isolated: pnpm run build:cursor-assets && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:cursor-assets && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.isolated.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:release: pnpm run build:cursor-assets && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:cursor-assets && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.release.yml --publish never
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:updater
scripts.test:runtime: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --experimental-strip-types --test src/main/appProtocol.test.ts src/main/statusMonitor.test.ts src/main/desktopAssets.test.ts src/main/statusMonitorLifecycle.test.ts src/main/upgradeInfo.test.ts src/main/embeddedComputerVersion.test.ts src/main/privateUpdateChecker.test.ts src/app/cursorSdkAssets.test.ts src/app/buildConfig.test.ts src/app/configuredApiOrigin.test.ts
scripts.build:cursor-assets: pnpm --filter @botiverse/raft-daemon build:cursor-assets -- --target darwin-arm64 && pnpm --filter @botiverse/raft-daemon build:cursor-assets -- --target darwin-x64
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/require-linux-build-origin.mjs && pnpm run build:cursor-assets:linux && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:cursor-assets:linux && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.linux.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:cursor-sdk: pnpm run build:cursor-assets:arm64 && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:cursor-assets:arm64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.cursor-sdk.yml --publish never && pnpm run verify:cursor-package
scripts.verify:cursor-assets: pnpm --filter @botiverse/raft-daemon build:cursor-assets -- --verify --require-registry --target darwin-arm64 && pnpm --filter @botiverse/raft-daemon build:cursor-assets -- --verify --require-registry --target darwin-x64
